account: Sacchi et al. (Frontiers in Ophthalmology, 24 April 2026) retrospectively analyzed two cases of caruncular oncocytoma. Both had been excised and confirmed histopathologically. ChatGPT (GPT-5, 2025 version) received only slit-lamp photographs and a brief summary (age, sex, site). It proposed oncocytoma as the primary hypothesis in both. Differentials included papilloma, nevus, squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma. The authors call it a proof of concept that a general-purpose multimodal model can recognize a rare ocular surface tumor, limited by the sample size. The analysis was run on 8 September 2025, months after confirmation, with no effect on care. The authors declare no competing interests. Publication was 24 April 2026. The authors also report three exploratory tests using published images of other tumor types. GPT-5’s leading diagnosis was wrong in all three against the authors’ stated labels. Perplexity proposed different leading diagnoses for the two main cases. These selected examples do not establish a diagnostic-accuracy rate.

fields.account: Sacchi et al. (Frontiers in Ophthalmology, 24 April 2026) retrospectively analyzed two cases of caruncular oncocytoma. Both had been excised and confirmed histopathologically. ChatGPT (GPT-5, 2025 version) received only slit-lamp photographs and a brief summary (age, sex, site). It proposed oncocytoma as the primary hypothesis in both. Differentials included papilloma, nevus, squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma. The authors call it a proof of concept that a general-purpose multimodal model can recognize a rare ocular surface tumor, limited by the sample size. The analysis was run on 8 September 2025, months after confirmation, with no effect on care. The authors declare no competing interests. Publication was 24 April 2026. The authors also report three exploratory tests using published images of other tumor types. GPT-5’s leading diagnosis was wrong in all three against the authors’ stated labels. Perplexity proposed different leading diagnoses for the two main cases. These selected examples do not establish a diagnostic-accuracy rate.
